info.title: Government Enterprise AI Platform API
info.summary: Governed API boundary for the sovereign enterprise AI platform.
info.description: The contract exposes only capabilities accepted in the approved phase roadmap. Navigation or contract visibility never grants authorization.

200.description: The API process is healthy.

get.description: Returns 503 until every required runtime boundary is connected. It reports identity, policy, governed-intent PostgreSQL, Neo4j Enterprise Graph, and Enterprise Context composition as unconfigured, invalid, or configured without exposing configuration values.

200.description: All required runtime boundaries are connected.

503.description: One or more runtime boundaries are not connected; the platform remains fail-closed.

get.summary: Read the approved Create Internal Service product foundation.
get.description: Returns public product metadata and the governed delivery sequence. It grants no execution authority.

200.description: The approved Create Internal Service product foundation.

post.summary: Validate a governed internal-service intent submission.
post.description: Requires authenticated identity, tenant, purpose, classification, permission, and authorization evidence. A successful validation is not persisted, is not an OPA decision, and cannot execute material work.

200.description: The intent passed server validation but was not persisted and cannot execute.

400.description: The submission shape or classification is invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Tenant, permission, clearance, purpose, or authorization evidence validation failed.

post.summary: Register a validated internal-service intent after OPA approval.
post.description: Requires authenticated authorization plus configured OPA and atomic evidence-bearing persistence adapters. Missing adapters, policy denial, or concurrency failure cannot create institutional state.

200.description: An idempotent retry matched the existing governed registration.

201.description: OPA permitted the request and intent plus registration evidence were created atomically.

400.description: The registration request, policy reference, or persisted response is invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Authorization or OPA denied the registration.

409.description: The expected registration version did not match.

503.description: The OPA policy gate or atomic registration repository is unavailable; no mutation occurred.

post.summary: Discover authorized Enterprise Context for a registered governed intent.
post.description: OPA establishes an explicit resource and modality scope before source access. Authorized retrieval re-checks every candidate before an evidence-bearing context snapshot is released. The result cannot advance to Existing Systems or invoke AI.

200.description: Authorized candidates were re-checked and released in a deterministic evidence-bearing snapshot that cannot advance.

400.description: The request, registered intent, policy decision, retrieval result, or evidence receipt is structurally invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Authorization or OPA denied Enterprise Context discovery.

404.description: The tenant-scoped governed intent registration was not found.

503.description: A registered-intent reader, OPA gate, retrieval source, or evidence recorder is unavailable; no source access or mutation occurred.

post.summary: Discover authorized existing systems for an evidence-bearing Enterprise Context snapshot.
post.description: OPA establishes explicit system-object, relationship-type, and source-kind scope before inventory access. Every system and relationship is structurally validated, re-authorized, and evidenced. No live connector, Enterprise Model mutation, or Existing Architecture advancement is available.

200.description: Authorized systems and relationships were released in a deterministic evidence-bearing snapshot that cannot advance.

400.description: The request, context, policy decision, inventory result, authorization result, or evidence receipt is structurally invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Authorization or OPA denied Existing Systems discovery.

404.description: The tenant-scoped authorized Enterprise Context snapshot was not found.

503.description: A context reader, OPA gate, inventory source, result authorizer, or evidence recorder is unavailable; no inventory source access or mutation occurred.

post.summary: Discover authorized existing architecture for an evidence-bearing Existing Systems snapshot.
post.description: OPA establishes explicit system, source, item-kind, relationship, and classification scope before architecture access. Every approved item is constitutionally checked, re-authorized, and evidenced. No architecture redesign, institutional mutation, or Approved Packages advancement is available.

200.description: Authorized approved architecture items were released in a deterministic evidence-bearing snapshot that cannot advance.

400.description: The request, prerequisite snapshot, policy decision, architecture result, conformance result, authorization result, or evidence receipt is structurally invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Authorization, OPA, result authorization, or constitutional conformance denied Existing Architecture discovery.

404.description: The tenant-scoped authorized Existing Systems snapshot was not found.

503.description: An Existing Systems reader, OPA gate, approved architecture source, conformance validator, result authorizer, or evidence recorder is unavailable; no architecture source access or mutation occurred.

post.summary: Select exact institutionally approved packages for an authorized architecture snapshot.
post.description: OPA authorizes exact immutable coordinates before registry reads. Eligibility, provenance, SBOM, signature, sovereign-registry assurance, and per-result authorization are required. No package transfer, execution, registry mutation, or AI Planning advancement is available.

200.description: Exact packages passed all governed controls and were released in a non-advancing evidence-bearing snapshot.

400.description: The request or a governed package boundary result is invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Authorization, OPA, eligibility, assurance, or result authorization denied selection.

404.description: The authorized Existing Architecture snapshot was not found.

503.description: A required architecture, policy, registry, assurance, authorization, or evidence adapter is unavailable; no registry access, package transfer, or mutation occurred.

post.summary: Create a governed non-executable AI planning candidate.
post.description: OPA, verified prompt, re-authorized context, exact approved packages, independent evaluation, result authorization, and evidence are mandatory. This planning endpoint cannot generate files, invoke tools, advance workflow, or invoke Code Generation.

200.description: A non-executable independently evaluated planning candidate was released.

403.description: Planning denied.

503.description: A planning dependency is unavailable; no AI invocation or context disclosure occurred.

post.summary: Create a governed non-executable and unapplied code candidate.
post.description: OPA, exact AI Planning evidence, a verified prompt, re-authorized context, exact approved packages, safe repository-relative output paths, independent evaluation, result authorization, and cryptographic evidence are mandatory. This endpoint cannot write or execute files, advance workflow, or invoke Static Validation.

200.description: A non-executable, unapplied, independently evaluated code candidate was released as evidence-bearing data.

400.description: The request, prerequisite, policy result, generated path, candidate, evaluation, authorization, or evidence result is invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Authorization, OPA, context authorization, evaluation, path scope, or result authorization denied generation.

404.description: A tenant-scoped AI Planning, Approved Packages, or delivery-run prerequisite was not found.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable; no AI invocation, context disclosure, filesystem access, workflow advancement, or mutation occurred.

post.summary: Run governed Static Validation against an authoritative inert code candidate.
post.description: Verified OPA authorizes the exact candidate and required Static controls before candidate read or control execution. Every exact control must complete with evidence and no Error or Critical finding. This endpoint cannot invoke Security Validation, execute code, mutate source, or advance workflow.

200.description: Every exact Static control passed with evidence; the non-advancing report was released.

400.description: The request or a governed validation boundary result is invalid.

401.description: A governed authenticated identity is required.

403.description: Access, OPA, a control result, or result authorization denied release.

404.description: The tenant-scoped generation candidate or delivery run was not found.

503.description: Policy, candidate reader, run reader, required Static controls, authorization, or evidence is unavailable; no candidate disclosure or control execution occurred.

post.summary: Run governed Security Validation after accepted Static Validation.
post.description: Verified OPA authorizes exact Static evidence, candidate, run, and signed Security controls before reads or control execution. Every exact control must complete with evidence and no Error or Critical finding. This endpoint cannot invoke Sandbox, execute code, mutate source, or advance workflow.

200.description: Every exact Security control passed with evidence.

403.description: Security Validation denied.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable; no disclosure or control execution occurred.

post.summary: Execute an authoritative candidate in the governed security sandbox.
post.description: Verified OPA authorizes the exact immutable Security evidence chain, institutional image, Firecracker-class isolation, non-secret environment, and network scope before a bounded signed provider-neutral sovereign Sandbox invocation. Readiness is unconfigured until deployment supplies the exact runtime, image, limits, trust, and endpoint. No production effect, Tests approval, or workflow advancement is available.

200.description: Isolated execution accepted, authorized, and evidenced without production effect.

403.description: Sandbox execution or result disclosure denied.

503.description: A required governed dependency or signed sovereign Sandbox runtime is unavailable; no image access or execution occurred.

post.summary: Run deterministic governed tests after accepted Sandbox execution.
post.description: Verified OPA authorizes the exact immutable Sandbox chain, governed manifest, institutional image, Firecracker-class isolation, environment, and network scope before a bounded signed sovereign test invocation. No production effect, Human Review approval, or workflow advancement is available.

200.description: Every required test passed and the result was authorized and evidenced without production effect.

403.description: Tests execution or result disclosure denied.

503.description: A required governed dependency is unavailable; no image transfer or test invocation occurred.

post.summary: Record an attested separation-of-duties Human Review decision after accepted Tests.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact human reviewer, decision, evidence package, and conflict scope before reads. The signed human decision is recorded atomically with evidence and cannot advance to Git or production.

200.description: The human approve or reject decision and cryptographic evidence were recorded atomically.

403.description: Reviewer access, separation of duties, OPA, or attestation denied.

503.description: A governed policy, reader, attestation, or atomic repository dependency is unavailable; no decision was persisted.

post.summary: Create one governed signed source commit after approving Human Review.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact candidate, review, change set, repository, base commit, non-protected branch, and metadata before repository access or source mutation. No force update, PR, CI/CD, workflow advancement, or production effect is available.

200.description: One exact signed commit was created and evidenced without CI/CD or production effect.

403.description: Git access, OPA, change policy, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no repository mutation occurred.

post.summary: Execute one governed CI/CD workflow for the exact signed Git commit.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact Git receipt, immutable workflow, isolated runner, ordered stages, and controls before checkout or invocation. Outputs remain non-released; no source mutation, artifact publication, deployment, production effect, or workflow advancement is available.

200.description: The exact governed pipeline completed and was evidenced without Artifact publication or deployment.

403.description: CI/CD access, OPA, workflow validation, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no checkout or pipeline invocation occurred.

post.summary: Publish one exact immutable Artifact from an accepted CI/CD output.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact pipeline manifest, artifact coordinate and digest, institutional registry, signing policy, and supply-chain controls before reads or publication. No deployment, production effect, or workflow advancement is available.

200.description: The exact immutable Artifact was published and supply-chain verified without deployment.

403.description: Artifact access, OPA, package, supply-chain, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no registry access or publication occurred.

post.summary: Deploy one exact verified Artifact to one approved sovereign environment.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact Artifact, sovereign profile, target, production intent, and human approval before reads or invocation. No telemetry, registration, Enterprise Model mutation, or workflow advancement is available.

200.description: The exact Artifact was deployed with activation, rollback, and evidence proof.

403.description: Deployment access, OPA, human approval, preflight, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no runtime invocation or external effect occurred.

post.summary: Activate governed OpenTelemetry for one exact Deployment.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact Deployment, profile, resource, signals, collectors, and redaction before reads or configuration. No automatic registration, Enterprise Model mutation, or workflow advancement is available.

200.description: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs were configured with redaction and evidence.

403.description: Telemetry access, OPA, redaction, collector, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no telemetry configuration occurred.

post.summary: Register one exact deployed and observed internal service.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact OpenTelemetry receipt, run, signed manifest, service key, policies, actions, relationships, and evidence before atomic registration. No workflow advancement or later station is available.

200.description: The exact service was registered atomically with authorization and evidence.

403.description: Registration access, OPA, manifest, repository, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no read or registration occurred.

post.summary: Confirm one exact registered service in authorized Enterprise Model context.
post.description: OPA authorizes the exact registration, Enterprise Object, tenant, classification, and evidence before reads. No model mutation, analysis, simulation, workflow advancement, or Evidence completion is available.

200.description: The exact registered service was confirmed in authorized Enterprise Model context with evidence.

403.description: Enterprise Model access, OPA, object, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no prerequisite or Enterprise Model read occurred.

post.summary: Append and verify the final cryptographic Evidence entry.
post.description: OPA and Evidence authorization precede access. The Phase 30 engine appends only the final Evidence entry and verifies the exact complete ten-stage chain. No later station exists.

200.description: The final Evidence entry was appended and the complete ten-stage chain cryptographically verified.

403.description: Evidence access, OPA, append, verification, or result authorization denied.

503.description: A governed dependency is unavailable; no prerequisite read or evidence append occurred.

200.description: OpenAPI 3.1 contract.

oidcBearer.description: OIDC/OAuth2 access token validated against the deployment-approved sovereign identity authority.

traceId.description: Trace identifier safe for the active disclosure context.
